about_pullquote: A tidy garden is the difference between a home and a showpiece.
about_para_1: Graysons was started over a decade ago because we saw too many Sheffield gardens left neglected. We started small — just grass cuts — and word spread through neighbourhoods. Today we look after regular customers across the city, from modest terraces to large country properties. We've grown by doing the same thing every time: turning up on schedule, doing honest work, and charging fairly.
about_para_2: Customers come back because we're reliable. We don't just mow and leave; we edge, collect clippings, and leave your garden looking cared for. Whether you need a one-off tidy or year-round care, we fit around your schedule and your budget. Sheffield's weather is unpredictable, but you can count on us.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Been using Graysons for three years now. Always on time, always does a proper job. My garden looks better than it ever did when I was trying to do it myself. Can't recommend them enough.

reviews.text: Called them in a panic because my hedge had gotten completely out of control. They came within a week, did the whole thing, and made it look like a garden again. Fair price too. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Claire B.

reviews.text: We moved house last summer and garden was a nightmare. One call to Graysons and they sorted it. Now they come every fortnight and it's the best money we spend. Great lads, take pride in their work.
reviews.author: David K.
